synopsis: On 23 March 2026, the US Department of Transportation told the D.C. Circuit it was preparing rulemaking to extend FMVSS No. 127 lead time by two years; this was a proposal, not an adopted extension [f2537]. Chapter 13 restates the planned amendment, while the glossary repeats the two-year extension with only a March 2026 date [f10867, f15424]. Separately, on-road evidence reported in a US DOT report and the McDonald et al. 2019 review found that evidence-accumulation models fitted to simulator data captured takeover braking better than fixed baseline reaction-time models [f3496].
